# Ultimate Edge Blog

> Practical, fact-checked guides on JAMB, WAEC, NECO, Post-UTME, and Nigerian university admissions — covering JAMB CAPS mechanics, result checking, aggregate score calculation, cut-off marks, and alternative admission pathways.

## JAMB CAPS & Admission Status

- [JAMB CAPS Explained](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/jamb-caps-explained): What the Central Admissions Processing System is, how to navigate it, and the four-week acceptance rule.
- [How to Check JAMB CAPS Admission Status](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/how-to-check-jamb-caps-admission-status): Step-by-step guide to checking your admission status on CAPS.
- [How to Accept Admission on JAMB CAPS](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/how-to-accept-admission-on-jamb-caps): How to accept an admission offer via the portal or SMS.
- [What to Do If JAMB CAPS Says Not Admitted](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/what-to-do-if-jamb-caps-says-not-admitted): Troubleshooting steps when your status shows no offer yet.
- [Admission in Progress Status Meaning](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/admission-in-progress-status-meaning): What the AIP status means and what happens next.
- [JAMB Change of Course Form](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/jamb-change-of-course-form): How to change your registered course on JAMB.
- [JAMB Change of Institution Portal](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/jamb-change-of-institution-portal): How to change your registered institution.
- [How to Retrieve JAMB Profile Code](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/how-to-retrieve-jamb-profile-code): Recovering a lost JAMB profile code via SMS.
- [How to Upload O'Level Result on JAMB Portal](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/how-to-upload-olevel-result-jamb-portal): Uploading WAEC/NECO results to your JAMB profile.

## Post-UTME

- [JAMB vs Post-UTME Difference](https://blog.ultimateedge.info/posts/jamb-vs-post-utme-difference): How JAMB UTME and institutional Post-UTME screening differ.
